title: Fiabila explores new frontiers in nail color, care, and packaging
summary: New shades and special effects, a patented nail care complex, new nail polish remover formats, and innovative bottle decoration solutions: Fiabila recently unveiled a series of developments that showcase the growing diversification of its expertise beyond nail polish. With new collections of colors and special effects, a technology platform dedicated to nail care, and several innovations in nail polish removers and packaging, Fiabila is expanding its offering across multiple segments.... - Innovation & new products

products.name: Oui Oui Baguette!
products.launch_quote: Among the new launches, the Oui Oui Baguette! collection draws inspiration from the French art of living, with a palette of rose-gold pearls, creamy neutrals, and toasted browns.

products.name: Bubble Fizz
products.launch_quote: Bubble Fizz features five translucent shades of blue, purple, and turquoise, enhanced with holographic micro-flakes and light-reactive pigments.

products.name: Celestial Wonders
products.launch_quote: The Celestial Wonders collection combines a velvety finish that softens the polish’s shine with iridescent pigments that shift blue shades towards pink and orange hues.

products.name: Urban Raw
products.launch_quote: With Urban Raw , Fiabila takes a more mineral and industrial approach.

products.name: Signature Collection Winter 2027
products.launch_quote: Rounding out the new launches, the Signature Collection Winter 2027 introduces 30 shades grouped into six color families, each with its corresponding HEX and Pantone references.

products.name: Matrix Lift Repair Base Coat
products.launch_quote: Matrix Lift Repair Base Coat combines the complex with the Lift+ Gel Matrix technology, designed to create immediate surface tension and encourage self-leveling.

products.name: Kera-Boost
products.launch_quote: Kera-Boost is a water-based serum containing 97% naturally derived ingredients.

products.name: BB Pastel Care
products.launch_quote: BB Pastel Care , meanwhile, comes in three signature shades – baby pink, baby blue, and baby coral – formulated as ultra-sheer corrective filters.

products.name: Bi Fuse Caring Oil
products.launch_quote: Completing the care range, Bi Fuse Caring Oil is a two-phase formula that must be shaken before use.

products.name: Glitter Haze Remover
products.launch_quote: Acetone-free Glitter Haze Remover features suspended glitter particles that redistribute when the bottle is shaken, adding a distinctive visual touch to the product.

products.name: Pump’n’Wipe
products.launch_quote: Pump’n’Wipe , meanwhile, comes in a cotton pump bottle designed to dispense a precise amount of formula.

products.name: Nail’n’hair Milky Serum
products.launch_quote: Finally, Nail’n’hair Milky Serum illustrates the growing convergence between nail and hair care.
